inspiration: Modular appearance: hair as separate parts with their own soft-rig bones and weights, shown as a secondary chain. Recreate as our own hair cards with a simple secondary bone chain. Reference: docs/img/elbera-tools-hair-soft.jpg (caption only).

Sparse keyframe animation: clips stored as sparse tracks with ordinary interpolation between keys, so few keys carry a full stance cycle. Recreate with our own sparse clip format. Reference: docs/img/elbera-tools-animation-keys.jpg.

NPC event frames: sound and effect events attached to specific frames of an idle loop, so a creature's grunt lands on a chosen pose. Recreate with our own event tags on frames. Reference: docs/img/elbera-tools-npc-notifies.jpg and docs/img/elbera-tools-live-npc-events.jpg.

Zone interior built from a BSP rendering pipeline, shown with repeated columns (caption words only). Recreate as our own interior with a circular or broken plan. Reference: docs/img/dungeon-elven-ruins.jpg.
Shoreline built from layers: water over terrain (caption words only). Recreate with our own shoreline tiles and a different palette. Reference: docs/img/water-splat-beach.jpg.

UI skin from a texture manifest that records true pixel sizes, plus a bitmap font built from a glyph sheet and a metrics file. Recreate the manifest idea with our own panels. Reference: tools/ui/build_uiskin.py and tools/ui/build_font.py.
Combat feedback: floating damage numbers and a ground loot pile after a kill. Recreate with our own number font and loot shape. Reference: docs/img/combat.jpg.
